app.services.torch: Data extraction with TORCH – status and API
app.services.portalHint: Define criteria and find out how many patients in Blaze match them.
app.services.torchHint: TORCH starts with the Data Portal package and extracts data from Blaze. In this local setup, extraction requests use the separate TORCH API. See the guide for instructions.
app.services.startHint: Run this command from the project directory. The Data Portal profile starts Blaze, Data Portal and TORCH with their supporting services. Status updates automatically. Plan for 24 GiB of Docker memory.
app.upload.startHint: You can start additional target servers with Docker Compose.

app.config.resourcesIntro: Choose the resources and encounter levels to include in the output. Configure how resources reference each other and which medication resources are additionally generated or replaced.
app.config.idsIntro: Configure patient IDs, initial resource counters and the number of additional repetitions. With suitable ID offsets, you can output the same input dataset repeatedly, creating resources with distinct IDs each time. Use time shifting to move clinical dates and times together by whole days.
app.config.terminologyIntro: Choose the catalogue year for Synthea code mapping and configure how terminology versions appear in the output.
app.config.outputIntro: Choose validation checks and output formats for conversion. Set the maximum number of patients per output file.
app.config.baseline: The KDS profile packages define the structure and required fields of FHIR resources: base {base}, laboratory {laboratory}, medication {medication}, consent {consent}. The catalogue year below selects the edition of the German code catalogues. Selecting 2025 therefore does not change the KDS profile packages. Each profile determines which catalogue years are permitted.
app.config.darHint: DAR rules replace existing values after derivations with a reason why the information is absent. Each field offers suitable codes. “As text” means the information is missing from the structured field but is present in the human-readable narrative of the FHIR resource. “Not performed” means, for example, that a measurement did not take place, rather than just its result being missing.

option.terminology.syntheaYear.help:
During Synthea import, diagnoses, procedures and medications are mapped to German ICD-10-GM, OPS and ATC codes from this year. Codes and descriptions can differ between 2025 and 2026; clinical dates stay the same. Manually entered workbook values are not remapped by this setting.

Warning: The bundled medication profile permits ATC versions up to 2025. ATC 2026 with its year included therefore violates this profile requirement.
option.terminology.syntheaYear.label: Synthea mapping year
option.terminology.versionOutput.help:
Controls version information for codes mapped during Synthea import. Codes and descriptions stay the same.

Catalogue year: Coding.version contains the year used, e.g. “2025”.

Omit: The version is absent. Since the KDS profiles require it for ICD-10-GM, OPS and ATC, validation reports profile errors.

DAR: A Data Absent Reason explains the missing version. It does not establish that the code belongs to a permitted catalogue year. DAR uses the field-specific version rules in the DAR section; without a selected rule, the version is omitted.
option.terminology.versionOutput.label: Coding version

option.timeShift.iterationDays.help: Add this day offset for each additional repetition. Example: base offset 10 and repetition offset 5 produce shifts of 10, 15 and 20 days in the first three passes.
option.timeShift.iterationDays.label: Additional shift per repetition in whole days

option.medication.MedicationAdministrati:
Retain: Output the MedicationAdministration.

Add: Also output a MedicationStatement with its own ID, retaining the MedicationAdministration.

Replace: Output a MedicationStatement instead of the MedicationAdministration.

option.medication.MedicationStatement.tr:

Add: Also output a MedicationAdministration with its own ID, retaining the MedicationStatement.

Replace: Output a MedicationAdministration instead of the MedicationStatement.

The target resource must itself be enabled. Addition and replacement are mutually exclusive. This also applies to resources from replaced MedicationRequests. Resources created in this step are not transformed again.
choice.contact-fill-missing: Derive missing encounter assignments from timestamps
choice.contact-timestamp-only: Always derive encounter assignments from timestamps
option.reference.DocumentReference.assig:
Supplied only: Retain supplied encounters. Without an input encounter, leave the reference absent.

Derive missing: Retain supplied encounters and use timestamp matching only when none is supplied. This is the default.

Always derive: Recompute encounters from timestamps, replacing supplied encounters. Without a usable timestamp or matching encounter, omit even supplied references and report the reason.

In the first two modes, retain temporally conflicting encounters and report the conflict. Encounters are identified by the combination of patient ID and case number. If this combination is absent from the input, the nonexistent encounter is reported.

option.resource.Encounter.ambulatory.ena: Select encounters with Encounter.class.code = AMB on all selected encounter levels. Shared encounter settings still apply. Other encounter classes are unchanged.
option.resource.Encounter.ambulatory.end: Applies to facility, department and ward/service encounters of this class. All calculations and assignments use original or internally derived periods first. The output end is adjusted afterwards. DAR takes precedence; the final status follows the output end. Resulting inconsistencies between parent and child periods are allowed as test data. Quarter/year end use the start after time shifting. Start + 1 second uses midnight as the calculation basis for a date without a time; otherwise date precision is preserved.

Always: replaces an end supplied in the input as well. Only when the input end is missing: checks the original table value. An internally derived end does not prevent the rule. This choice has no effect when preserving input and derivations.

option.resource.Observation.laboratory.u: Output code in unit instead of code

For UCUM-coded measurements, move the machine-readable code from code to unit and remove code. This produces faulty test data, for example when mmol/L appears only in unit. Applies to valueQuantity and component.valueQuantity. Replaces the readable unit text; value, comparator and system are retained. DAR rules are applied afterwards. FHIR validation may report errors for this output.
option.resource.Observation.vitalSigns.u: Output code in unit instead of code

For UCUM-coded measurements, move the machine-readable code from code to unit and remove code. This produces faulty test data, for example when mmol/L appears only in unit. Applies to valueQuantity and component.valueQuantity. Replaces the readable unit text; value, comparator and system are retained. DAR rules are applied afterwards. FHIR validation may report errors for this output.
app.uploadWorkbookLimit: Excel (.xlsx), CSV or Synthea ZIP, Synthea JSON · up to 64 MiB. ZIP files must be at the archive root. The original file stays unchanged.
app.uploadWorkbookFailed: The input could not be uploaded.
app.inputListFailed: Saved inputs could not be loaded.
app.workbookInspectionHint: Excel: checks sheet structure and column headings. CSV: also checks file groups, record structure and patient assignments using the shared converter. Row counts exclude headers. Further clinical checks run during conversion.
app.syntheaInspectionHint: Inspection counts resources and patients in the JSON bundles. The run imports Synthea R4 data through the Excel template and reports imported and unsupported content. Bundles without patients are skipped.
app.generation.title: Generate Synthea data
app.generation.hint: Seeds determine random sequences. Matching seeds, dates, settings and Synthea version make generation repeatable. KDS output uses the current editor settings.
app.generation.loadFailed: Could not load settings for the installed Synthea version.
app.generation.timestampSeeds: Use the current timestamp as seed
app.generation.timestampSeedsHint: The current Unix timestamp in milliseconds is applied at submission and saved with the run. Switch off to use the manual values again.
app.generation.overflow: Generate additional patients to replace deceased patients
app.generation.selectionHint: The exported patient count can differ from the requested count. Replacing deceased patients can produce additional bundles. Vital status and selection modules restrict accepted patients; unsuitable combinations can reach the attempt limit.
app.generation.modulesHint: No selection: all available modules. Selecting modules restricts disease and care processes; core processes remain active. Info icons explain the effects and show examples.
app.generation.invalid: Check number ranges, seeds and dates. The reference date must be on or before the simulation end; the end cannot be in the future.
app.datasets.title: Datasets and reports
app.datasets.failed: Could not load the result overview.
app.datasets.incomplete: This run failed. Available datasets and reports support inspection; they do not establish a successful import.
app.datasets.countHint: Counted formats: {formats}. Repeated resource IDs: {repeated}. Resources without IDs: {missing}. Counting is not FHIR validation.
app.datasets.reportCounts: Import issues: {issues} · omitted content: {omissions} · failed cases: {failures} · end derivations: {derivations} · output decisions: {selections} · validation: {errors} errors, {warnings} warnings
app.datasets.fileHint: Files download directly. The complete run ZIP contains all results and reports; dataset ZIPs contain the FHIR files of one configuration.
app.datasets.moreFiles: Showing the first 200 matches. Use search to narrow the selection.
app.datasets.searchRuns: Find runs by input, configuration or status
app.generation.nativeHint: Generates original Synthea FHIR R4 JSON data. The KDS configuration does not apply.
app.upload.title: Load datasets into FHIR servers
app.upload.hint: Select datasets and a target server. Existing resources with the same ID are updated. Conflicting contents within this selection are reported before loading.
app.upload.error: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
app.upload.conflictDetail: {resource} has conflicting contents. Nothing was uploaded. Please change the selection.
app.upload.partial: Some resources may already have been uploaded. The server state was not rolled back.
app.failure.memory: The run failed because memory was exhausted. Generated files may be incomplete. Use less history or smaller inputs and check available memory.
app.failure.killed: The process was forcibly terminated. Memory exhaustion is a possible but unconfirmed cause. Generated files may be incomplete.
app.loadRunHelp: Loads this run’s saved input, generation settings and FHIR configuration into the editor, replacing current settings. Edit them and start a new run when ready.
app.downloadHelp: ZIP containing output files, logs and this run’s saved configuration snapshot (snapshot.json).
app.deleteRunConfirm: Permanently delete this run and its local inputs, results and logs? Uploaded FHIR data and upload history will be retained.
identifier.typeHelp: The list includes identifier types from the bundled FHIR and KDS profiles. System, code and display are editable. All types are available for all selected resources. Multiple codings describe the same identifier type.
dar.onlyWhenMissing: Only when no value is present
dar.onlyWhenMissingHelp: Sets DAR only for missing values after conversion. Existing input and derived values are retained. When unchecked, the rule also replaces existing values.
option.stationServiceProvider.label: Ward as service provider
option.stationServiceProvider.help: Uses the ward of the ward/service encounter as an Organization in Encounter.serviceProvider. Its stable ID is based on facility, department and ward. A contained organization is embedded in the Encounter; an external organization can be generated or only referenced.
option.stationLocation.label: Output ward as Location
option.stationLocation.help: Creates the ward Location with physicalType wa. Can be combined with the ward organization. Room and bed can still be represented independently; Location output settings also apply.
